typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		RPT_DT as timestamp,
		PLTFM_TXT as string,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		CREATE_DTTM as timestamp,
		LAST_UPD_DTTM as timestamp,
		LAST_ALTER_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_DCL_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_DDL_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_DML_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_DQL_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_OTHER_SQL_DT as timestamp,
		USERNAME as string,
		USER_FULL_NAME as string,
		USER_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		USER_ROLE_LIST as string,
		EMP_ID as string,
		LAST_ACCESS_DT as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		sandbox_name as string,
		platform_name as string,
		environment_name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(ENVRN_TXT == environment_name && DATABASENAME == sandbox_name,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		USER_FULL_NAME as string,
		USER_ROLE_LIST as string,
		USER_EMP_ID as string,
		RPT_DT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		USERNAME as string,
		LAST_ACCESS_DT as string,
		USER_EMAIL_ADDR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ENVRN_TXT,
		USER_FULL_NAME,
		USER_ROLE_LIST,
		USER_EMP_ID = EMP_ID,
		RPT_DT,
		DATABASENAME,
		USERNAME,
		LAST_ACCESS_DT,
		USER_EMAIL_ADDR),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
